title: Oka manifolds are ubiquitous
summary: We prove that a holomorphic family of connected complex Lie groups has Oka total space if and only if its base is Oka. Extension presentations and generating sections give Oka results for stable and parabolic bundle moduli and for holomorphic mapping and embedding spaces. Every nonempty degree component of maps from a compact Oka curve to projective space is Oka; rational-function spaces are also holomorphically elliptic.
